author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
Learn how to secure the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the standard that connects AI agents to tools and data. This course walks through how MCP works, the "lethal trifecta" of agent risk, and every item on the OWASP MCP Top 10, each with a real-world incident and the fixes that stop it.

Course created by Dan Barahona, founder of AI Security University.

Get your free certificate: take the final quiz at https://aisec.university/fcc-mcp
You'll get a certificate of completion, a badge for your LinkedIn profile, and 2 CPE credits.

More free AI security courses, weekly live events and a community of practitioners: https://aisec.university
